svg.title: Reducing along axis 0 and axis 1
svg.desc: A 4 by 3 grid of poses: rows 0.0 0.0 0.00; 1.0 0.0 0.00; 2.0 0.5 0.46; 2.5 1.5 1.11. Tag 1: an arrow runs down each column to a row of three means below the grid, 1.375, 0.5 and 0.3925 (axis=0). Tag 2: an arrow runs along each row to a column of four maxima at the right, 0.0, 1.0, 2.0 and 2.5 (axis=1).
